signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in deep zone coverage, 20+ yards from the LoS and outside the hash marks.
Defenders with this ability are rarely faked out by ballcarrier moves (and cannot be faked out when user-controlled).
Defenders with this ability will have full vision of plays the offense has run a scaling number of times each quarter, via coach cam.
A surehanded receiver is a quarterback's best friend. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their success rate (and decreases knockout chance) on possession catches.
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 10-20 yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
Receivers with this ability make sharper cuts and frequently win contested catches when covered by linebackers and linemen.
When lined up at tight end, players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes during pre-play adjustments.
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke and spin animations.
When lined up at wide receiver (excluding slot), players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes during pre-play adjustments.
Receivers with this ability have a high success rate when creating separation on the last cut of any route.
Passers with this ability improve the catching prowess of all running backs who are open on pass plays.
Passers with this ability have faster passing animations when they are throwing under pressure
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all throws outside the numbers (except on high/low throws).
Aggressive receivers overpower defenders and attack the football. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their success rate on aggressive catches against single coverage.
Receivers with this ability make sharper cuts and frequently win contested catches when covered by linebackers and linemen.
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 10-20 yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
When lined up at any wide receiver position, players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes during pre-play adjustments.
Blockers with this ability reduce an edge pass rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move
During preplay, players with this ability will highlight any oncoming blitzers on 3rd and 4th downs. Can be bluffed.
Players with this ability can detect user-controlled defenders before the snap; as well as 3rd and 4th down blitzers. Can be bluffed.
